Sentiment -The Real Driver of Crypto Prices

Crypto prices are sensitive to sentiment. 

➞ News headlines
➞ Social media trends
➞ Public figures endorsements (like Elon Musk with Dogecoin) 

Can swing crypto prices wildly, often more than traditional economic factors.

2. Memecoins are More Than a Trend

Memecoins like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu are reshaping market behavior and offering a gateway to mainstream crypto adoption.

Memecoins are trending 

Dogecoin and Shiba Inu have proven that even fun, community-driven tokens can achieve significant market capitalization.

They’re now a fixture in mainstream crypto culture, driven by pop culture and influencer support https://t.co/JthzIHRtgy

Sumit on Musk
Elon Musk has already played a role in bringing crypto to the masses

Musk’s support for Bitcoin & Dogecoin sparked widespread interest in crypto from mainstream audiences

Musk’s influence, combined with Trump’s policy, could fuel the next phase of crypto adoption https://t.co/YOsJKdy7fQ
